description: Generic editor config for the unified workspace-aware lsp-server/lsp-types authoring adapter.
notes: Replace `.` with the workspace root and `--axi` with the default canonical root for `.cq` diagnostics.
The canonical generated contract is `axiograph authoring integration-manifest --workspace <root>`.

LSP diagnostics derive from the full canonical report. executeCommand defaults to compact authoring_workspace_response_v1; presentation.detail=full returns authoring_workspace_report_v1. The same typed sections and anchor-bound pagination apply.
The adapter is read-only and cannot mutate accepted ontology state.
